title: Rovers and slopes
purpose: Teach why rovers have a slope limit, what VIPER's design limit is, and why the safe route can be the longer one.

beats.label: measured
beats.sub: The game's rover and its roads are fiction

captions: Lunar dust is loose, so steep slopes make rover wheels slip.
NASA's VIPER rover was designed to climb slopes up to {slope}°.
Any steeper, and it has to find another way around.
On a map, the shortest line can be the steepest.
A longer, gentler route is often the safe one.
That limit is VIPER's design figure.
ends_on: Check the slope before you drive. The short way is not always the safe way.
